register_verify_record.meaning: exit 0: the record carries the register's provenance stamp and its digest matches; exit 3: UNVERIFIED — which the tool itself defines as 'predates provenance, or something else wrote it', NOT as forged. A record from the first pass predates the stamp (it is YAML with no produced_by), so exit 3 is the expected result and says nothing either way. Neither exit says WHEN a record was written, and the register is the artifact under study.

register_sha.digests: register.yaml as it stood when drain-end wrote the run record (register.py register_sha() at the pass-end commit)
register_sha.meaning: a match binds the run record to the exact register file next to it — the register has not changed since the record was written, or both were written together. It is consistency, not write-time provenance: a later reconstruction writing both files would also match.
register_sha.note_on_history: the run-state directory is ignored by version control and `git log --all -- <dir>/` is empty on every ref, so no committed copy of the register exists to compare against; only the file beside the record can be checked, and it is.
